CIBC slashes gold price forecasts but sees recovery to $5,200 in 2027 as central bank demand offsets Fed headwinds
fcst_sentences: In its latest precious metals outlook, commodity analysts at CIBC Capital Markets lowered their fourth-quarter gold price forecast to $4,500 an ounce, down 31% from their $6,500 estimate from the start of the year.
The bank now expects gold prices to average $5,200 an ounce in 2027, down from its previous forecast of $6,500, and $5,500 in 2028, compared with its earlier estimate of $6,000.
Long-term, the bank expects gold prices to average $4,800 an ounce in 2029, $4,500 in 2030 and $4,200 in 2031.
